headline: Blown lead in Miami completes Marlins sweep
recap: The Phillies coughed up a three-run lead in Wednesday's 8-6 loss at Miami, completing a three-game sweep by the Marlins. Philadelphia was up 6-3 through five innings before the Marlins tied it with three in the seventh and pushed two more across in the eighth. Trea Turner led the way with two hits, including his 15th home run, Justin Crawford also had two, and Bryson Stott drove in a pair.

Jesús Luzardo carried the lead into the seventh but finished charged with six runs over 6.1 innings. Jonathan Bowlan allowed the go-ahead runs an inning later and took the loss. At 57-52 the Phillies sit second in the NL East, six games behind Atlanta, and have now dropped three straight.

Thursday is an off day. Philadelphia opens a weekend series in Baltimore on Friday at 7:05 PM ET, with Brandon Young lined up for the Orioles and no Phillies starter announced yet. No betting line is posted this far out.
